tags.name: screencap
tags.description:
This tag is for screen captures, even animations or whole video sections, from the official MLP content. **This is not used for screencaps in general.** 
 
Also remember to tag the title of the episode/short/movie it is from. 
 
[Edited screencaps](https://derpibooru.org/tags/edited+screencap) (such as image macros and memes, for example) should also be tagged as such.
tags.short_description: Screencaptures (including animations or whole video sections) from official MLP videos

tags.name: edit
tags.description: Use this tag **ONLY** when it is someone other than the original artist altering the image. Use [`alternate version`](/tags/alternate+version) if it is the original artist making the changes.
tags.short_description: Edits to images done by third parties. NOT for changes made by the original artist.

tags.name: alternate version
tags.description:
Use this tag instead of [`edit`](/tags/edit) when it is the original artist who has made alterations to the image. Don’t use this tag even if you used “alternate version” of some image to make an edit.

One image that's thought of as the "original" needs to *not* be tagged as an "alternate version". The "original" should be the image with the [lowest rating](/pages/tags) and fewest embellishments; if that's not a clear choice, then it should be the image that was uploaded first.
tags.short_description: For changes made by the original artist.

tags.name: edited screencap
tags.description:
A [screencap](/tags/screencap) that has had something in view changed to be different from what you would see in the actual original media.
Do not use for screencaps that have only been cropped.
tags.short_description: A screencap with something in the visible area changed other than accurate captioning.

tags.name: derpibooru exclusive
tags.description:
Any image that was posted directly to Derpibooru by its creator, and as such the original source of the image is Derpibooru itself. This still applies if *someone else* re-uploads the image elsewhere, such as Twitter or e621, as long as the original creator only posts it here. Pictures with this tag should not be tagged with [source needed](/tags/source+needed). 
 
The "Best Artist" badge ![tiny](https://derpicdn.net/badges/2016/8/24/959565a53c58fc015b6b96.svg)
is awarded to verified artists who upload 5 "derpibooru exclusive" images of their own creation, and which have reached 100 upvotes (or more) and are not edits, image macros, or exploitable memes.
tags.short_description: Images that have been exclusively posted to the booru.
